The checkpoint was never created locally. This was a silent prepare/post-commit mismatch, not a push or checkpoint-remote failure.
Evidence:

At 17:38:12, checkpoint 01KX3RF0... was successfully condensed. This cleared the session’s tracked files.
At 17:38:27, the Pi session transitioned to idle.
A new Pi prompt arrived one second later, but no corresponding turn-start event appears in the Entire log.
Pi edited two files and committed them.
At 17:39:25, prepare-commit-msg generated and appended 01KX3RH9GBCZD3A40K3G6X1N9N.
There is no subsequent session condensed entry for that ID.
At 17:39:38, after the commit, turn-end handling migrated the session to c32690e and created a new ephemeral shadow checkpoint instead.
The failure mechanism is:

prepare-commit-msg found the new file operations by inspecting Pi’s live transcript, so it added the trailer.
post-commit saw an IDLE session whose persisted FilesTouched was empty.
For non-active sessions, it did not re-extract touched files from the live transcript.
The overlap guard therefore rejected condensation, silently leaving the commit with a dangling checkpoint trailer.
The relevant evidence is in [entire.log (line 1106)](/Users/peter/code/devenv/cli/.entire/logs/entire.log:1106) and the third Pi turn begins at [the Pi transcript (line 60)](/Users/peter/.pi/agent/sessions/--Users-peter-code-devenv-cli--/2026-07-09T15-31-37-593Z_019f4781-81f9-753d-ab2e-bd75b0cec3cf.jsonl:60). The current implementation still has the active-only file fallback in [manual_commit_hooks.go (line 1255)](/Users/peter/code/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go:1255), so this scenario appears to remain possible.
This disproves two initial hypotheses:

It was not lost during push: the persistent checkpoint was never written locally.
Checkpoint ID generation did not fail: the ID was successfully generated and added to the commit.
Fix direction: add a regression test for IDLE + empty FilesTouched + new live-transcript edits, then either re-extract files during post-commit or persist the positive prepare-hook association. Separately, investigate why Pi did not emit turn-start for that third, rapidly submitted trail-review prompt. Also, a warning should be logged whenever a commit contains a trailer but no checkpoint is materialized.
